(3rd Level)

“Nothing is ever lost. It is only misfiled.”

You gain controlled access to the Akashic Layer.

  • You may maintain +1 additional active Precedent beyond normal limits.

  • When you create a Precedent, you must specify which aspect is recorded:

    • Intent (why it was done)

    • Outcome (what happened)

    • Method (how it was done)

    • Cost (what it required)

    • Emotional Weight (fear, hope, shame, etc.)

That chosen aspect “sticks hardest” and is the most enforceable when cited later.

Surge Interaction

When you spend a Surge to interact with that Precedent, the recorded aspect gains narrative priority during adjudication.

Pushback Risk

Recording too many events too quickly can generate Noise. Lore (Mind) resists being micromanaged.
